title: Two-AI Critique Workflow
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting two-ai critique workflow to AI critique log showing accepted, modified, and rejected suggestions, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Sort critiques from two independent AI tools into agreement, conflict, and unique, and explain why the conflict bucket carries the most value
Break a tool-vs-tool conflict using an external anchor (the job posting or rubric) rather than the tool's tone or order
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions
Use feedback, support requests, and revision notes to improve the artifact before sharing it

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
